questions.category: C1 - Use diagnostic tools and equipment
questions.question: A motorcycle has an intermittent misfire and a stored DTC for the TPS. What should the technician do first?
options: Clear the code and return the bike
Check service data, connector condition, TPS signal, reference voltage, and ground
questions.explanation: A DTC identifies a circuit or system, not always the failed part. The technician should verify power, ground, signal, and connector integrity. Live data and service specifications help confirm the fault.

questions.question: A motorcycle was dropped and now pulls slightly to one side. No obvious damage is visible. What should be inspected?
options: Frame alignment, fork alignment, swingarm, and mounting points
questions.explanation: Chassis damage may be hidden after impact. Frame, fork, and swingarm alignment affect tracking and handling. A safe repair requires inspection against manufacturer specifications.

questions.category: E3 - Maintain steering systems for multi-wheeled motorcycles
questions.question: A three-wheeled motorcycle shows rapid front tire wear on both tires. What is a likely cause?
questions.explanation: Multi-wheeled motorcycles are sensitive to toe settings. Incorrect toe causes tire scrub and unstable tracking. Steering linkage and suspension play should also be inspected.

questions.category: E4 - Maintain chassis standard and accessory components
questions.question: After installing aftermarket handlebars, the throttle does not return freely at full lock. What is the best action?
options: Check throttle cable routing, free play, and handlebar clearance
questions.explanation: The throttle must return freely at all steering positions. Handlebar changes can alter cable routing and create binding. A sticking throttle is a serious safety hazard. --- ## F. MAINTAIN SUSPENSION SYSTEMS — 7 Questions ### F1. Maintain Front Suspension Components — 3 Questions

questions.question: A front fork seal leaks repeatedly after replacement. What should be inspected closely?
options: Fork tube surface for pits, rust, or scratches
questions.explanation: Damaged fork tube surfaces can cut new seals. Replacing only the seal may not fix the root cause. Tube condition, bushings, and alignment should be checked.
